prompt:

Header text verbatim: "herrn". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "sir".
Scene: Adult cafe server politely offers coffee to an older male customer, respectful eye contact, no nobility symbols.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "herrn = sir here; a polite way to address a man.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Vill herrn ha kaffe?".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
